introduction: Nebraska Aid to Dependent Children is the state’s TANF-funded cash-assistance program. Employment First participants are moving into a new TANF pilot beginning October 1, 2026.
description: Nebraska Aid to Dependent Children is the state’s TANF-funded cash-assistance program. Employment First participants are moving into a new TANF pilot beginning October 1, 2026

sections.who: ADC serves eligible low-income families with children. DHHS reviews the family and financial criteria and applicable participation rules; certain caregiver or disability circumstances affect the assistance rules.
sections.get: Approved families receive cash support. Adults able to work are linked to Employment First services for employment preparation and support.
sections.docs:

  • Have children’s identity and relationship records available.
  • Keep medical or caregiver information relevant to the participation assessment.
sections.apply:
1. Start through iServe

    Apply at iServe Nebraska or ask a DHHS office about assistance.

  2. Explain the family circumstances

    Identify the children and caregivers and supply the records requested by DHHS.

  3. Review participation instructions

    Ask how the TANF pilot affects your Employment First activities and what you must complete next.
sections.after: Keep the decision and participation notices together. Tell your worker about barriers that affect attendance, work or required cooperation.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current Nebraska ADC/TANF overview and pilot notice, iServe application guidance. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is ADC different from Nebraska TANF?
ADC is the cash program funded through TANF.
The current TANF page says new and existing participants move into the pilot starting October 1, 2026.
Do all cases have identical time limits?
No. The state describes different treatment for specified non-parent caregiver and disability circumstances. Ask about your case.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
